card.name: Weight-based dosing and becquerel units
card.fires_on: The word weight (or the end of BSA) after body in weight-based dosing instructions, and the middle of becquerel units such as MBq or megabecquerels in radiopharmaceutical doses.

modes.label: Body weight in dosing
modes.description: The word weight or the end of a weight-related term, where the dose is calculated from the patient's body size.
